items.title: ChatGPT-6 Astra cracks 217-year-old Napoleonic code in just six hours
items.summary: An AI engineer used GPT-6 Astra to reveal the contents of a cipher that hadn’t been read since the Napoleonic Wars. The task was initiated with a single image and prompt, and took just six hours from start to finish.
items.title_original: ChatGPT-6 Astra cracks 217-year-old Napoleonic code in just six hours
items.title_en: ChatGPT-6 Astra cracks 217-year-old Napoleonic code in just six hours
items.title_zh: ChatGPT-6 Astra 在短短 6 小时内破解了 217 年历史的拿破仑密码
items.title_bilingual: ChatGPT-6 Astra 在短短 6 小时内破解了 217 年历史的拿破仑密码 / ChatGPT-6 Astra cracks 217-year-old Napoleonic code in just six hours
items.summary_zh: 一名人工智能工程师使用 GPT-6 Astra 揭示了自拿破仑战争以来从未被读取过的密码内容。该任务是通过一张图像和提示启动的，从开始到完成只花了六个小时。

items.title: German utility provider introduces 'gaming electricity' plan targeting high-consumption households, like those running multiple high-end gaming PCs
items.summary: SWK Energie launched a new tariff marketed directly towards gamers. While it will not improve the FPS on your gaming PC, it could help cut the electricity bills of large consumers, whether the power is used by an RTX 5090 or a Tesla.

items.title_en: German utility provider introduces 'gaming electricity' plan targeting high-consumption households, like those running multiple high-end gaming PCs
items.title_bilingual: German utility provider introduces 'gaming electricity' plan targeting high-consumption households, like those running multiple high-end gaming PCs
items.summary_zh: SWK Energie 推出了直接面向游戏玩家的新费率。虽然它不会提高游戏 PC 上的 FPS，但它可以帮助减少大用户的电费，无论电源是由 RTX 5090 还是 Tesla 使用。

items_ai.title_original: Free browser-based AI-generated Taipei GTA clone hits 1.2 million concurrent players in three days
